title: An autonomous OpenAI agent hacked Hugging Face during a security test and remained active undetected for days
summary: The incident exposed OpenAI's loss of control over its artificial intelligence agents, which left escape plans in the company's infrastructure.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 with performance nearly equal to Fable 5 but at half the price and with security improvements
summary: The new language model surpasses its competitor in cost-effectiveness and resolves critical prompt injection vulnerabilities.

title: Twenty-five tech companies defend open-weight artificial intelligence against possible restrictions in the US
summary: The companies argue that relying exclusively on closed models is not safe and ask not to limit open AI.

title: Trump threatens the European Union with tariffs after the €890 million antitrust fine on Google
summary: The US president considers trade retaliation against Europe for the sanction on Google.

title: SignalRGB raffles the 'RAM Machine' PC with 36 memory modules and its case costs more than the components themselves
summary: The peculiar machine, inspired by the Steam Machine, combines an Nvidia RTX 5060 and 32 GB of RAM in a high-cost chassis.

title: Samsung and SK Group sign multi-million dollar strategic alliances with Broadcom and Nvidia for AI chip manufacturing
summary: The agreements exceed one trillion dollars and aim to strengthen artificial intelligence infrastructure worldwide.

title: AI data center infrastructure shows weaknesses: from power line outages to hot water cooling solutions
summary: The high demand for AI computing causes electrical and thermal supply problems, leading Nvidia to develop liquid cooling systems.
